resources.string:
A small helper that does what MacroDroid cannot do on its own when a macro asks.

• Open notifications directly — remembers how to open each notification as it arrives, so tapping it in the Message Alerts list opens that exact chat or email.
• Car recognition — tells the parking macros which paired Bluetooth devices are cars (hands-free / car audio).
• Barometer — measures air pressure so the parking macro can guess which floor you parked on.

Everything stays on this phone. It is never saved to a file or sent anywhere.
⚠️ Notification access: off — turn on \"MD Helper\" with the button below
